description:
The demon lord was killed, and 820 years after that, many big technological advancements had been made across the globe. The trendiest profession nowadays is.... "Personalized Live-Streaming"!

Erin, an Elf influencer who claims that she's the 'best in the whole-wide-world', and Belle, an Orc who is a culinary instructor, are going to launch a (chaotic) cooking show called "A Live-Streaming Elf's Culinary Channel"!

It's about to go live!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=841052), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6604980)
